context_dependency: Explicitly indexed by context C (DEC-SEM-002). Context-free variants are rejected.
trace_compatibility_truth_conditions: TraceCompatible_C(t, w) evaluates to true iff execution trace t matches the relational step boundaries and transition invariants required by w in context C.

rejected_trace_models.description: Context-free trace compatibility. Rejected because admissibility thresholds and relation indexes vary across contexts.
Equating trace compatibility with witness validity. Rejected because trace compatibility is a necessary but not sufficient condition for witness validity.
rejected_trace_models.basis: SD-006 (finite executable proxy vs. formal semantic object).

remaining_ambiguities: Should TraceCompatible_C evaluate to false or remain undefined when the trace t contains out-of-bounds evaluation steps?
